description: DEEP V1 DeepSwap swap math (side-dependent fees in the quote token). Written by packages/curve-math/scripts/gen-fixtures.ts (pnpm fixtures); consumed by packages/curve-math, packages/sdk, programs/deep-amm (curve/v1.rs) and integrations/jupiter. Amounts and rates are decimal strings, rates are per 1e6. isBuy = the input is the pool's quote token (fee off the input); otherwise the fee comes off the output. exactIn / exactOut: ok false = the Rust function returns None (one cap: lpRate + protocolRate + rewardRate <= maxTotalFeeRate). poolRates: ok false = PoolState::v1_rates errors (lpRate + protocolRate > maxTotalFeeRate - maxRewardRate, or a non-Standard snapshot > maxRewardRate).
